jobs.description:
**About Us:**

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at **insightsoftware.com.**

**Job Description:**

Software Engineer I, JustPerform

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Software Engineer I to join the JustPerform product team. JustPerform is an enterprise software product in the financial performance management space, supporting workflows in areas such as financial planning, analysis, and financial close. You will work across the full stack, building features on a Vue 3 frontend and a Spring Boot backend, for customers who operate in complex, high-stakes financial environments.

This is a role for someone who is past the learning curve of the basics and ready to take on meaningful feature work independently. You will be expected to contribute across both frontend and backend, write code that your teammates are happy to review, and bring a genuine curiosity about how modern tools, including AI, can make you a better engineer.

**What You'll Do**

**Feature development**

* Build and maintain full-stack features across the Vue 3 frontend and Spring Boot backend, working from well-defined requirements through to production.

* Write clean, well-structured code with appropriate test coverage, and participate actively in code reviews on both sides of the stack.

* Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand requirements, ask the right questions, and flag technical constraints early.

* Debug and resolve issues across the stack, taking ownership of a problem until it is properly resolved rather than passing it along.

* Contribute to technical discussions, design sessions, and sprint planning with a constructive point of view.

**Frontend engineering (Vue 3)**

* Build UI components and features using Vue 3 with the Composition API, with attention to performance, reusability, and maintainability.

* Manage application state using Pinia, keeping data flows predictable and easy to reason about.

* Integrate frontend components cleanly with backend APIs, handling async data flows, loading states, and error scenarios correctly.

* Write TypeScript across the frontend codebase, maintaining type safety and consistency with established patterns.

* Write component-level tests using Vitest, and contribute to frontend quality standards across the team.

**Backend engineering (Spring Boot)**

* Design and implement REST APIs using Spring Boot, following established patterns for structure, validation, and error handling.

* Work with relational databases: write efficient queries, understand indexing basics, and contribute to schema changes with appropriate migrations.

* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and standard Spring testing utilities, maintaining meaningful coverage on the code you ship.

* Participate in backend code reviews and contribute to improving the quality and consistency of backend code over time.

* Learn and apply the team's existing patterns for authentication, authorization, and service-layer design as you contribute to new features.

**AI-assisted development**

* Use AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) as a regular part of your development workflow to write, review, and improve code more efficiently.

* Bring a thoughtful approach to AI-assisted development: know when suggestions are good, when they need revision, and when to discard them entirely.

* Experiment with AI tooling beyond basic code completion, such as using agents or custom skills to automate repetitive development tasks, generate test scaffolding, or accelerate documentation.

* Share what you learn about effective AI tooling with your team, contributing to a culture where the team improves its use of these tools over time.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 3 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience in a full-stack or backend-leaning role.

* Solid hands-on experience with Vue 3 using the Composition API; you have built real features with it, not just followed tutorials.

* Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and maintaining REST APIs in a production environment.

* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing queries, understanding joins and indexes, and contributing to schema design.

* Familiarity with TypeScript in a frontend codebase; comfortable with types, interfaces, and generics at a working level.

* Experience writing tests across the stack: Vitest for Vue 3 component and unit testing on the frontend, JUnit for unit and integration testing on the backend.

* Experience with Pinia for state management in Vue 3 applications.

* Familiarity with Git workflows in a team environment: branching, pull requests, code review, and resolving conflicts.

* Awareness and hands-on experimentation with AI coding tools; you have used them in your own workflow and formed a view on where they help.

* Clear communication: able to ask good questions, articulate what you are working on, and flag blockers early rather than late.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working on enterprise software, particularly in finance, ERP, or performance management domains.

* Exposure to custom AI agents or workflow automation tools beyond basic code completion.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerised environments (Docker, GitHub Actions).

* Knowledge of Spring Security or similar frameworks for authentication and authorization.

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

Are you passionate about building secure, scalable, and automated cloud networking solutions at enterprise scale? As a **Senior Technical Product Manager** within Optum's Public Cloud organization, you will play a pivotal role in driving the evolution of our multi-cloud networking capabilities across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will partner with engineering teams, cloud architects, security leaders, and application teams to modernize networking experiences that accelerate cloud adoption while ensuring compliance, reliability, and operational excellence. You will help define requirements, drive prioritization, and execute strategic networking initiatives that enable thousands of developers and hundreds of cloud workloads across the enterprise.

This role is ideal for an experienced technical product manager who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and delivering products that simplify cloud networking for application teams.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership and Strategy (20%)**

* Own and drive specific cloud networking product areas within the Public Cloud portfolio, including connectivity, ingress/egress, service networking, network security, traffic management, DNS, and hybrid cloud networking
* Partner with senior product leadership to define vision, roadmap priorities, and quarterly objectives for networking capabilities
* Work closely with application teams to understand networking challenges, onboarding friction points, and operational pain points
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, self-service experiences, scalability, and developer productivity
* Translate business and technical requirements into product roadmaps and delivery plans

**Execution and Delivery (60%)**

* Manage and prioritize networking product backlogs across multiple engineering teams
* Define detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
* Lead delivery of cloud networking initiatives spanning Azure, AWS, and GCP environments
* Drive improvements in cloud onboarding, network provisioning, firewall automation, service connectivity, and developer enablement workflows
* Coordinate delivery dependencies across engineering, security, compliance, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Monitor product health, adoption metrics, reliability measures, and customer satisfaction indicators
* Support release planning, testing, rollout strategies, and operational readiness activities
* Drive issue resolution and continuous improvement initiatives through customer feedback and operational insights

**Stakeholder Management and Collaboration (20%)**

* Serve as a trusted partner to engineering managers, architects, security teams, and application stakeholders
* Facilitate alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities and objectives
* Communicate roadmap progress, delivery updates, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes to leadership
* Support portfolio-level planning, quarterly business reviews, and strategic initiatives
* Champion customer-focused product development and data-driven decision making

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any directives that may arise as business needs evolve. The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion.

**Required Qualifications (8-12 + Yrs ) : -**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of product management experience with technical infrastructure, cloud platform, networking, or enterprise technology products
* 3+ years of experience working with public cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, private connectivity, VPNs, and hybrid networking
* Experience working with cloud-native networking services such as Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Cloud DNS, Azure DNS, Application Gateway, Load Balancers, and related technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams using Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements and customer value propositions
* Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and successfully deliver complex initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. * **Define** the product vision, target users, success measures, and multi-quarter roadmap for platform and framework capabilities.
* **Own** backlog management end-to-end, including intake, discovery, prioritization, requirements, acceptance criteria, and release planning.

* **Execute** enablement and adoption plans, including positioning, rollout approach, documentation, training, and feedback loops for continuous improvement.
* **Improve** developer experience through scalable onboarding, reference implementations, templates, and a support model that reduces friction and increases time-to-value.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Hands-on experience building and operating Java-based services, including application programming interfaces and distributed systems.
* 8+ years of product management experience (or equivalent expertise in a closely related domain).
* Experience defining product vision, success measures, and roadmaps and delivering against them in changing environments.
* Demonstrated backlog ownership, including discovery, prioritization, dependency management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong understanding of event-driven system design concepts (for example: messaging patterns, ordering, retries, and idempotency).

* Experience using operational and customer signals (metrics, incidents, performance data, support themes) to make prioritization decisions and demonstrate value.
* Proven ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Strong written communication skills for product requirements, decision records, and roadmap narratives.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience building or scaling developer platforms, shared libraries, service frameworks, or reference implementations.
* Familiarity with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Spring Security ecosystems.
* Familiarity with reactive versus traditional web service patterns and schema-based interface approaches such as GraphQL.
* Experience defining governance for interfaces, including versioning and deprecation practices.
* Experience leading adoption programs for internal platforms, including enablement content and success measurement.
* Familiarity with observability practices, including service-level measures, logging, metrics, tracing, and incident review processes.
* Experience supporting artificial-intelligence-enabled products or development practices, including evaluation methods, monitoring approaches, and governance considerations.

  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. The Defender for Office 365 product group owns the protection experience for email and collaboration across Microsoft 365.
  
  
The product management team drives end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle, partnering with groups and stakeholders across the organization and directly with customers and partners.
  
  
As part of Microsoft XDR, the product spans real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting, and pre-breach capabilities.
  
  
The team owns one of the largest security solutions in the XDR portfolio and helps shape how communication and productivity security will work in an era of AI-powered social engineering, using AI to strengthen detection and making MDO the trusted entry point into the broader Defender suite.
  
  
The group works at the intersection of protection efficacy, explainability and everyday usability, serving SOC analysts, email administrators and end users alike. Product and engineering are located in IDC and ILDC, as part of the Defender global team.

Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. It is part of the Microsoft XDR portfolio, delivering real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting for SOC analysts and email administrators, along with pre-breach posture and risk reduction. Attackers are shifting from recognizable malicious artifacts toward adaptive, multi-step social engineering and our job is to stay ahead of that shift while keeping protection explainable and operable at enterprise scale.

**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

Job Title

**Business Analyst – Alpha Index HUB**

  

**Organization**

Alpha Product Organization – Alpha Index HUB (AIH)

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The role supports the design, build, testing, and rollout of scalable index and benchmark data capabilities that are critical to Alpha’s data platform.

This position works closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), Operations, and third‑party data vendors to ensure product enhancements are well‑defined, operable, auditable, and aligned with Alpha product strategy and delivery standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product & Requirements Management**

* Partner with Product Owners to define, document, and refine product requirements aligned with Alpha Index HUB strategy and roadmap.

* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable through development and testing phases.
  

  

**Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration**

* Facilitate discussions to ensure shared understanding of scope, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with Operations teams to incorporate operational workflows, controls, and exception handling into product requirements.
  

  

**Delivery & Execution Support**

**Operational Readiness & Risk Management**

* Assist with documentation and communication of field definitions, status meanings, and operational behaviors to reduce ambiguity and risk.
  

  

**Continuous Improvement**

* Support ongoing evolution and maturity of Alpha Index HUB capabilities in alignment with broader Alpha product and platform initiatives.
  

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* **15+ years of experience** as a Business Analyst, with level determined by role (BA, BA II, Senior BA).
* Experience working in a product‑led or Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
* Proven experience producing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  

  

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Hands‑on experience writing and reviewing SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
* Working knowledge of running, monitoring, and validating processes in the Charles River Development (CRD) environment, including awareness of upstream/downstream dependencies, batch processing, and operational workflows.
  

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.
  

**Reporting & Alignment**

* Reports into the Alpha Product Organization.
* Works in close partnership with Alpha Index HUB Product Owners, Engineering leads, QA teams, and Operations stakeholders.
* Embedded within product delivery cadence, including sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.
  

**Measures of Success**

* Requirements are clearly defined, consistently understood, and require minimal rework.
* Engineering and QA teams can deliver features efficiently with reduced clarification cycles.
* Operations teams gain improved visibility, consistency, and confidence in Alpha Index HUB processing.
* Product enhancements materially improve platform reliability, transparency, and scalability.

jobs.title: AI Business Analyst – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**About The Role**
At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we enable high-value AI solutions (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic systems) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services, and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (typically ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC).
  
  
To support our rapid-turnaround, high-velocity engineering teams, we are seeking a highly skilled, deeply experienced IT Business Analyst. Operating in a highly regulated pharmaceutical and clinical environment (GxP), you will serve as the strategic interface between complex business priorities, regulatory compliance frameworks, and cutting-edge engineering realities. You are not a traditional analyst who merely documents requests; you are a passionate, technically literate individual contributor equipped with advanced AI skills (including prompt engineering & modern agentic workflows) and the business acumen to collaborate closely with product leaders. Furthermore, you possess strong Product Owner (PO) skills and are fully prepared to confidently act as a Proxy PO for the squad if necessary—managing the product backlog, defining sprint goals, and steering delivery timelines to align with Roche’s strategic objectives.
  
  
****Core Tech Stack & Scope****
This role requires a deep understanding of three core domains: AI systems, the life sciences and pharmaceutical business context, and the complexities of operating within a highly regulated environment.
  
  
The IT Business Analyst serves as the strategic bridge between complex business requirements and cutting-edge technical execution. You will take ownership of the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for AI initiatives, ensuring that all architectural designs and engineering deliverables are scalable, high-performing, and strictly compliant with global regulatory standards. By aligning technical roadmaps with strategic priorities, you will drive the delivery of robust AI solutions that provide measurable business value and maintain the highest levels of data integrity and quality assurance.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):**

* Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization
* Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks
* Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals

**LLM Prompt Engineering & Solution Prototyping:**

* Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs
* Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration

**Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:**

* Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications
* Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps
* Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows

**GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):**

* Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11
* Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports
* Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states

**AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:**

* Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied
* Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases

**Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:**

* Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards
* Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections

**Audit Readiness & Operational Support:**

* Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices
* Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions

**Practical Skills Required**
****Experience**

* 8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes
* 5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors
* 3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies

The purpose of the role is to liaison and bridging the gap between customer and Wipro delivery team to comprehend and analyze customer requirements and articulating aptly to delivery teams thereby, ensuring right solutioning to the customer.

Job Category

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Business Analyst – Q2C Rapid Delivery (AMER Shift)
  
  
**Description**
Salesforce's Quote to Cash (QTC) Innovation team is looking for a Business Analyst, Q2C Rapid Delivery to join our growing organization. This isn't a traditional documentation-and-handoff BA role — we're looking for someone who thinks like an analyst but builds like an engineer: someone who can turn a business problem into a working solution using AI tools, not just a requirements doc.
  
  
You'll work on enterprise-level projects that scale and streamline internal Quote-to-Cash processes and operations, and you'll collaborate closely with Business SMEs, Product, Architecture, and Engineering Teams. Beyond mapping requirements and handing them off, you'll be expected to prototype, automate, and stand up working tools yourself — using AI-assisted ("vibe coding") tools as your default way of working. We are seeking proactive, self-motivated builders who are comfortable navigating ambiguity, take initiative, and drive project outcomes with minimal oversight.
  
  
You'll be working closely with our US-based teams, with an approximate shift schedule of 5:00 PM IST to 2:00 AM IST, subject to change based on project needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop deep functional expertise across Q2C domain areas (e.g., CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Order Management) over time, building the subject-matter depth needed to anticipate upstream/downstream impacts and guide solution design — not just execute against a defined spec.
* Partner with Functional Leads and Business SMEs to understand the future-state vision for Quote-to-Cash systems and processes — then go beyond documentation to prototype and build the enhancement yourself using AI-assisted tools.
* Lead requirements discovery with SMEs and stakeholders, and translate findings directly into working artifacts (automations, agents, test scripts, dashboards) rather than static specs alone.
* Map as-is/to-be processes and data flows (Lucidchart or equivalent), replacing manual process diagrams with automated, reusable tooling where possible.
* Build and maintain lightweight automations, workflow tools, and AI agents that solve recurring operational problems.
* Support data migration: mapping, validation, and reconciliation, increasingly via scripted/AI-assisted validation rather than manual checks.
* Use data analysis and BI skills to identify patterns, track KPIs, and build reusable reporting and monitoring.
* Own end-to-end delivery for smaller, well-scoped requests within a fast, iterative cadence — triage, build, validate, and ship.
* Lead and participate in UAT cycles, using automated/AI-driven testing approaches where possible rather than relying solely on manual testing.
* Maintain clear documentation of business rules, configurations, and the automations/agents you build.
* Partner with enablement teams on training and change management for new tools and workflows being rolled out.
* Stay current on emerging AI/automation tooling and actively pilot new approaches for the team.

**Required Skills/Experience**

* 3+ years experience in a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar delivery capacity, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise environment — with demonstrated comfort moving from requirements into hands-on building.
* Background in Quote-to-Cash, CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Order Management systems.
* Direct experience using AI-assisted development/automation tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to build working solutions, scripts, or agents — not just conceptual familiarity.
* Familiarity with Lucidchart, Smartsheets, or similar tools for process/project documentation.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving delivery environment.
* Excellent communication skills — able to work with both business and technical stakeholders and explain what an AI-built solution does and why.
* Curious, proactive, builder mindset — someone who prefers shipping a working prototype over writing a longer spec.
* Hands-on experience with data migration, validation, or system integration projects.
* Proven aptitude for data analysis/reporting — SQL/SOQL, and Tableau/PowerBI or similar BI tools.

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce administration, automation platforms (flows, AI agents, process builders), or workflow/bot building tools.
* Experience building or maintaining automated UAT/testing frameworks.
* Exposure to large-scale transformation, data-heavy, or M&A integration initiatives.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction or Business Operations teams.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for …

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose :**

  

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems.
* Work with probabilistic systems, defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to AI agents and workers, and how they hand off.

* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes.
* Owns the evaluation portfolio for new AI tools and platforms across Enterprise AI.
* Decides what graduates into a standing platform tower, what holds, and what gets retired.
* Owns the AI developer tooling estate end to end.
* Hands graduated platforms over with a working operating model.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Evaluation & Graduation**
---------------------------

* **Run every evaluation to a decision.** Set the hypothesis, the success bar, the comparison set, and the kill date up front. Keep a live view of what is in flight, on hold, or retired.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible adoption and retirement cases that survive finance and architecture scrutiny — engineering hours saved, licence cost avoided, capability gained, duplication removed.
* **Tell new capability from repackaging** so overlap with what GSK already runs is caught before it becomes duplicate spend.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping**
------------------------------------------------

* **Shape the emerging tech portfolio.** Keep a living view of in-flight, queued, and retired evaluations with the rationale for each call, and feed it into the AI Platforms & Tools portfolio.
* **Make the graduate, retire, or hold call.** Decide which tower receives a graduating platform, and hold the decision date when the organisation would rather extend it.
* **Protect the estate from sprawl.** Say no, with evidence, to tools that look attractive but do not change what the organisation can actually do.

**Required skil**ls:

  

* 16+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise AI platforms and developer tooling — how they are licensed, entitled, supported, and adopted at scale — and of at least one part of the pharma value chain.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, AI agents and workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience leading a small engineering team while operating with a span of influence far wider than the headcount — leading through frameworks, evidence, and quality of thinking.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Preferred skills:**

  

* Hands on with the AI platform ecosystem as a daily practitioner: fluent in how the landscape is categorised, where the category boundaries actually fall, and which capabilities are genuinely distinct from each other.
* Able to evaluate from first principles and to design the evaluation itself: set the hypothesis, the success bar, the comparison set, and the decision date, and defend the method to engineers and vendors alike.
* A proven record of retiring and consolidating technology, including at least one tool killed on evidence.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, Artificial Intelligence, Change Management, Data Analysis, Feature Prioritization, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Model Management, ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager for Agentic Operations who will lead the day-to-day management, optimization, governance, and performance of AI agents that support Marketing business operations. This role combines product ownership, operations management, AI fluency, analytics, risk management, and stakeholder engagement to ensure agentic solutions deliver reliable, measurable, and compliant business outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage operational guardrails for agent and LLM usage, ensuring agent activity stays within defined thresholds for time, cost, risk, autonomy, escalation, and business-approved use.
* Establish and monitor controls that prevent unmanaged agent behavior, including runaway loops, excessive retries, unsupported tool use, policy exceptions, and outputs that exceed approved risk tolerance.
* Oversee the resilience of agent operations by defining fallback paths, failover routines, human-in-the-loop escalation, exception handling, and continuity plans when agents, models, tools, or knowledge sources are unavailable or degraded.
* Monitor and improve agent response-time performance across priority workflows, identifying latency drivers and partnering with technology teams to optimize routing, orchestration, caching, context handling, and service-level expectations.
* Evaluate whether the selected LLM, model, or model tier is appropriate for each task, balancing quality, complexity, latency, cost, risk, and the required level of reasoning before routing work to higher-capability models.
* Maintain visibility into token usage, model consumption, cost trends, and capacity requirements at the agent, workflow, business area, and portfolio levels.
* Translate token, cost, latency, risk, and usage data into capacity management recommendations that keep the agentic operating model aligned with business-area strategic priorities.
* Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates agent health, performance, resilience, risk posture, capacity consumption, and recommended prioritization decisions.
* Partner with product, technology, risk, compliance, analytics, and business stakeholders to refine operating standards and ensure agentic capabilities scale responsibly across the enterprise.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, digital product management, marketing technology, AI-enabled operations, business execution, risk management, or a related function
* 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or directing the work of individual contributors, project teams, or cross-functional delivery partners.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience managing or supporting enterprise marketing capabilities such as marketing automation, audience operations, campaign orchestration, personalization, customer engagement, content operations, or marketing workflow platforms.
* Experience with AI-enabled marketing operations, enterprise AI platforms, LLM-based capabilities, agent orchestration, observability tools, knowledge management, or workflow automation.
* Proficient understanding of marketing platforms, campaign operations, customer engagement capabilities, workflow orchestration, and the controls required to operate in a regulated financial services environment.
* Experience managing resources, objectives, priorities, and operating routines within a functional area, including capacity planning, performance tracking, issue resolution, and escalation management.
* Demonstrated ability to manage moderately complex to complex business, operational, technical, or risk challenges using data, sound judgment, and structured decision-making.
* Experience partnering with product, technology, analytics, compliance, risk, controls, legal, and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes while managing dependencies and risk.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate technical, operational, and risk concepts into clear business recommendations for managers and senior leaders.
* Ability to operate with a risk mindset, drive operational excellence, simplify processes, and hold teams accountable for quality, timeliness, and business outcomes.
* Experience applying governance, audit, privacy, information classification, responsible AI, model risk, or control expectations to digital, marketing, or technology-enabled business processes.
* Experience developing operating models, playbooks, performance scorecards, executive reporting, adoption plans, and capacity management routines for a business or platform function.
* Experience leading through ambiguity, influencing without direct authority, and aligning cross-functional partners around strategic priorities, trade-off decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Financial services, consumer banking, lending, or regulated marketing experience.
* Experience with agile delivery practices, backlog prioritization, PI planning, Jira, product roadmaps, or cross-functional delivery routines.

**Job Expectations:**

* AI agents consistently meet defined accuracy, quality, compliance, and escalation standards.
* Agent adoption increases across priority user groups and business workflows.
* Operational issues are identified quickly, remediated effectively, and prevented through improved controls.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility into agent performance, business value, risks, and roadmap priorities.
* Agentic capabilities scale responsibly while improving productivity, speed, consistency, and decision support.

jobs.title: Operations specialist, CSBA
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, hungry and passionate about e-commerce? Are you an experienced professional with a strong work ethic and a bias for action? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. The ideal candidate is energized by digging into messy data, forming a hypothesis, finding the root cause, and driving a fix to closure across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for an Operations Specialist who shares Amazon's passion for the customer, someone who understands that a dependable delivery and fulfillment experience is central to how both sellers and buyers experience the Amazon platform.  
  
In this role, you will work closely with sellers, seller support, customer service, sales, and third-party carriers to identify delivery and fulfillment issues that sellers face, and resolve their acute and short-term problems. You will investigate why sellers struggle with or leave fulfillment programs, separate seller-owned gaps from Amazon-owned gaps, and recommend specific fixes. You will also partner with product management teams to translate recurring seller pain points into longer-term features and programs that improve the seller and customer experience.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Monitor operational performance and partner with other teams (third-party carriers, customer service, seller support, product, operations) to resolve performance issues and keep metrics within goal.  
Monitor and drive seller-impacting operational tickets and escalations to resolution within defined service levels, flagging anything at risk of breaching its window ahead of time.  
Run structured deep dives into seller friction and program attrition: pull and sanity-check the data yourself, form a hypothesis, establish the root cause with transaction-level evidence, identify whether the gap sits with the seller or with Amazon, and recommend a fix.  
Review and investigate incoming seller issues and feedback from multiple sources, and route each finding to the right team with a clear owner and next step, leaving nothing open at the end of the week.  
Size cost and savings opportunities across marketplaces and fulfillment methods, explaining what the numbers mean rather than passing dashboard output through unchanged.  
Build and run recurring operational reports (including automating them where possible) and produce weekly business-review inputs that lead with the headline metric, the week-over-week movement, and the reason for any change.  
Gather and analyze seller contacts and feedback to develop seller-experience improvement suggestions, and work with Product Managers on solutions.  
Must be open to working on Saturday and Sunday, with any other 2 days of the week off.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
* Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Vice President Marketing**

**Purpose of the role**

The Global Marketing function is focused on supporting the strategic and revenue growth priorities of the Bank. The function focuses on understanding customers and the identification, development and execution of marketing strategies, campaigns and activities that support and strengthen the HSBC brand, support the drive for revenue, and increase customer value and satisfaction in order to meet agreed targets and objectives at both a global and market level.

This role is part of the Asset Management Marketing & Client Experience team where the candidate will be Benguluru-based, and part of Marketing Center of Excellence for Asset Management, while the role primarily supports institutional and product capabilities, you will be required to work across the spectrum of solutions and Products in the HSBC Asset Management business, as required.

This role is responsible for the implementation of Asset Management global initiatives that requires strong project management skills, a passion for accuracy, a focus on attention to detail, and an ability to operate systems. This role forms part of a dynamic team that spans the delivery of global marketing plans.

* Strong understanding of the asset management industry, including investment products, investment capabilities and asset classes.
* Ability to work through complex processes and procedures, with experience of working in a regulated industry and adhering to complex procedures and processes.
* Strong project management capability to move initiatives forward in a cross-functional and matrixed operations organisational model, with a flexible and proactive attitude to respond effectively to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Design-oriented approach to build compelling slides and other marketing materials, keeping end users and the audience in mind; supported by very good presentation skills and the ability to depict complexity and support a thesis.

* Strong collaboration and people skills, including being a proven team player able to work with globally distributed teams and influence across multiple teams, communicate clearly and accurately with stakeholders, partners and colleagues, and demonstrate strong interpersonal and people management capabilities; self-starter who can work collaboratively, influence and motivate others, and thrive in a diverse work environment.

jobs.description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of next-generation compliance technology solutions across traditional payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and AI-enabled compliance capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of Compliance, Product and Technology driving the development of platforms that enable scalable compliance controls while supporting business growth and innovation. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in Financial Crime Compliance (AML, Sanctions, KYC, Transaction Monitoring), strong knowledge of Crypto and Stablecoin ecosystems, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform compliance operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Ownership:

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Compliance Technology platforms.
* Drive product innovation across AML, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Case Management, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Develop scalable compliance solutions supporting both traditional payment rails and digital asset ecosystems.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.

Financial Crime Compliance:

* Translate regulatory requirements into product features and technical capabilities.
* Design and enhance controls supporting:
  + AML/CFT
  + Sanctions Screening
  + KYC/KYB & Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Enhanced Due Diligence
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Case Management & Investigations
* Collaborate with Compliance Operations teams to optimise alert management and investigation workflows.

Crypto & Stablecoin Compliance:

* Lead compliance technology initiatives supporting stablecoin-enabled payment products and digital asset ecosystems.
* Design controls for:
  + Blockchain analytics
  + Wallet screening
  + On-chain transaction monitoring
  + Travel Rule compliance
  + Crypto onboarding and risk assessment
  + Stablecoin transaction monitoring
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to embed compliance controls within digital asset products and services.
* Evaluate emerging regulatory frameworks and assess impacts on product and technology strategies.

AI & Emerging Technologies:

* Champion the application of AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Automation across compliance programs.
* Develop AI governance, explainability, and model oversight requirements in partnership with Compliance and Risk teams.
* Evaluate AI vendors and emerging technologies to strengthen compliance capabilities.

Technical Product Delivery:

* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
* Lead integrations with internal platforms and external providers.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, UAT, production validation, and release planning.
* Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and enable data-driven decisions.

Stakeholder Leadership:

* Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Commercial teams.
* Lead requirement workshops, design reviews, and governance forums.
* Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global teams.
* Present strategy, roadmap progress, and key decisions to executives and leadership teams.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Compliance Technology, FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services.
* Deep understanding of:
  + AML/CFT frameworks
  + Sanctions Compliance
  + Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Financial Crime Investigations
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale compliance technology solutions.
* Strong knowledge of payments, money movement, and fintech ecosystems.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Crypto, Digital Assets, Stablecoins, Blockchain Analytics, or Travel Rule solutions.
* Knowledge of stablecoin regulatory frameworks and compliance controls.
* Experience implementing AI/ML-enabled compliance solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data architecture, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022, ISO 8583, and modern payment architectures.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by leading payment products that deliver clear customer value and measurable business outcomes. Join our team to grow your career through end-to-end product ownership, cross-functional leadership, and high-visibility launches. Bring your technical product expertise to build scalable, resilient capabilities and improve client experiences.

As a Product Manager (Vice President) at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Bank in the Payments Treasury unit you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you act as the voice of the customer and develop profitable products that provide customer value. You guide product launches, gather feedback, and ensure strong client experiences. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products with a focus on scalability, resiliency, and stability.

This role focuses on setting product direction, leading discovery, and delivering iteratively with an agile team to improve adoption, customer experience, and operational outcomes. The scope includes building partner-ready platform capabilities, supporting safe and compliant launches, and managing external integrations with networks and vendors. The role requires comfort using data to define success metrics, evaluate trade-offs, and drive prioritization decisions. The role also includes evaluating where artificial intelligence can create practical customer value within product experiences and workflows.

* **Set** product strategy and vision for your product area to deliver clear customer value, and translate that vision into a prioritized roadmap.

* Experience at a financial technology firm or in a bank–financial technology partnership, including embedded finance or banking as a service.
* Commercial card, business-to-business payments, or treasury experience (for example, purchasing card, travel and expense, virtual card, accounts payable automation, or supplier enablement).
* Familiarity with card network rules, interchange economics, and issuer processing.
* Exposure to enterprise resource planning and spend platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or Workday.

jobs.description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

Overview  
  
  

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**
  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

  

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

  

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

  

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.
