jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
**The Team**
Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products and connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating — challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.
  
  
****Job Summary****
As a Principal Product Manager for the AI Security team, you will lead the strategy and development for the innovative PRISMA AIRS product line. You will define and deliver competitive service offerings by deeply understanding customer needs through collaboration with sales, marketing, and engineering. Your role is crucial in creating marketing materials and evangelizing services to enhance the customer product experience. Success in this position hinges on your ability to guide and influence diverse cross-functional teams across the organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Understand AI systems, their differentiation from traditional software, and the evolving AI threat landscape.
* Serve as a strategic advisor, providing expert guidance to various cross-functional teams.
* Translate customer insights and competitive intelligence into differentiated product designs for engineering teams.
* Drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating resilience and a high bias for action to meet goals.
* Use data analytics to monitor metrics, identify trends, and influence the AI Security product roadmap.
* Oversee daily product management, including feature sets and overall strategy for the AI Security space.
* Lead feature prioritization and make critical tradeoff decisions to align with strategic goals.
* Support the full New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle, including Beta testing and feature ramp-up.
* Conduct market analysis, develop requirements, and create business cases to define product strategy and positioning.
* Maintain a strong customer focus through active engagement and relationship development.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 14 years of product management experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a history of data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated experience with enterprise-grade products and platforms.
* Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle, from conception to launch.
* Experience working effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience thriving in an agile environment with rapid iteration and collaborative work sessions.
* A demonstrable and consistent track record of success in previous roles.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Advanced degree such as an MBA or equivalent.
* Product management experience for AI/ML or Cybersecurity-driven products.
* Experience with cybersecurity and AI/ML-powered solutions for an enterprise platform.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Listings, EM SX
jobs.description:
**Description**
Every day, millions of customers rely on Amazon to give them access to one of the world's largest selection of consumer goods. Catalog is foundational to Amazon retail, acting as the base for both the customer and fulfilment shopper CX. At same time, we need to make the catalog creation process aka Listings simpler for our sellers. Our vision is to enable SPs of any size to list their selection quickly, easily and in a self-service manner. The EM SX Listings team creates tools to enable sellers to create high quality listings on amazon with minimum friction. We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own & drive improvements to simplify seller experience in listings their products on Amazon across desktop, mobile and APIs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to facilitate the effortless creation of Amazon listings by sellers. The role entails the crucial responsibility of empowering selling partners, comprising both sellers and vendors, to efficiently and effectively list their products on the Amazon marketplace. The goal is to ensure that these product listings maintain their buyability for the maximum possible duration, all while simplifying the process and minimizing hurdles for sellers to qualify for Amazon's platform.
  
  
The individual in this role will have end-to-end ownership, which includes defining the overall strategy, collaborating with engineering and machine learning teams to develop solutions, and meticulously monitoring metrics to track progress across Amazon's extensive eCommerce pipeline. Furthermore, they must grasp the intricacies of emerging markets and strategize accordingly for sellers within the Amazon ecosystem. This necessitates close collaboration with numerous global teams, often requiring the ability to influence without direct authority. It is also imperative that the role holder stays abreast of the latest technological advancements, including Large Language Models, and present a product strategy that leverages these innovations to simplify the listing process.
  
  
This role is highly influential, with significant business impact, and provides visibility to leaders both in India and across the global platform teams. Regular updates to senior leadership are essential, and it requires a high degree of ownership, a bias for taking action, and thinking on a grand scale in an environment where contributions are distributed among multiple stakeholders. Exceptional influencing skills are crucial to drive initiatives forward. Additionally, international connectivity is key, and the individual must be willing to invest in building networks with business and tech teams on a global scale.
  
  
A successful candidate for this role should have a proven background in product management, scaling systems with extensive data sets, and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced setting. Strong development experience, familiarity with software development cycles, and a history of managing large cross-functional projects are essential. Given the inherent ambiguity in the role, analytical thinking and superb problem-solving skills are also prerequisites, as many of the challenges are unique to Amazon's vast scale.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Manage business and technical requirements, ensuring overall coordination, quality, and acting as the primary contact for global stakeholders of your products and goals.
* Collaborate with scientists, economists, and engineers to deliver scalable ML models and generate customer insights at scale, while building project roadmaps.
* Apply scientific, engineering, and business best practices to drive innovation.
* Create high-quality documents (narratives & PR FAQs) to articulate your vision and report on initiatives to senior leadership.
* Influence feature and priority decisions with tech and platform teams based on overall impact and speed to market.
* Advocate for the needs of Emerging Market customers on a global stage.

**About The Team**
The Emerging Market Seller Experience (EM SX) team envisions Amazon as the preferred marketplace for Selling Partners in Emerging Markets. They strive to simplify the process for any Selling Partner to launch and expand a successful business on Amazon. The Listings team within this group develops tools and products that reduce friction for Amazon sellers when listing their products. Serving as the voice of sellers in Emerging Markets (including IN, MENA, APAC, LATAM), they create user-friendly, scalable solutions to address their unique needs.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

**proven, hands-on experience in owning and building B2B SaaS / technology products.**

The ideal candidate should have experience across
**0-to-1 and 1-to-N product journeys**
—from identifying problems and validating opportunities to defining, building, launching, scaling, and continuously improving products.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in
**startups, product-led companies, or lean product teams**
, with significant end-to-end product ownership. Experience as a
**Founding Product Manager, first/only Product Manager, or a PM working closely with founders/CEO**
will be highly relevant. This role requires someone who can
**build a new product from scratch while also owning and evolving existing products and product lines.**

**About the Company**

Smart Food Safe is a pioneering software company specializing in
**Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, and Traceability management solutions**
. The company provides a customizable suite of advanced tools designed to streamline processes, ensure compliance, and improve product quality, empowering organizations of all sizes.

With a strong focus on innovation and real-time operational visibility, Smart Food Safe helps businesses address emerging food safety and regulatory challenges. By combining cutting-edge technology with an affordable and customer-centric approach, the company remains a trusted partner in optimizing food safety and quality management across the supply chain.

**Role Overview**

As a
**Product Manager**
, you will drive the
**strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution**
of Smart Food Safe’s B2B SaaS products.

You will work closely with the
**CEO, engineering, design, QA, marketing, sales, and functional teams**
to identify customer problems, define product opportunities, build new products from
**0-to-1**
, and evolve existing products from
**1-to-N**
.

This role requires strong
**product thinking, customer understanding, ownership, and execution ability**
. You will be expected to translate customer and business problems into practical product solutions and work closely with engineering and design teams to take them from concept to delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the
  **product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities**
  aligned with business goals.
* Identify and validate
  **customer problems, market opportunities, and product ideas**
  through research, discovery, and customer interactions.
* Own products
  **end-to-end**
  , from discovery and definition through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Build new products from
  **0-to-1**
  and scale/refine existing products from
  **1-to-N**
  .
* Translate customer needs and business requirements into
  **PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and feature specifications**
  .
* Manage and prioritize the
  **product backlog**
  and work closely with engineering during sprint planning, development, testing, and releases.
* Collaborate with
  **engineering, design, and QA teams**
  to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery.
* Track
  **product metrics, customer feedback, and usage patterns**
  to identify improvements and measure product performance.
* Work closely with
  **sales, marketing, and functional consulting teams**
  on product positioning, customer requirements, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to
  **understand problems, validate solutions, and gather product insights**
  .
* Maintain
  **Jira or other product/project management platforms**
  to support the technology team and ensure execution visibility.

**Required Skillset**

* Proven experience managing and owning
  **B2B SaaS / technology products**
  and complete product lifecycles.
* Strong understanding of
  **0-to-1 product development and 1-to-N product scaling**
  .
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and
  **data-driven product decision-making**
  skills.
* Ability to work effectively in
  **Agile/Scrum**
  development environments.
* Experience with product management tools such as
  **Jira, Notion, Confluence, ClickUp, or similar**
  .
* Basic understanding of
  **software development, APIs, integrations, AI, and modern web applications**
  .
* Familiarity with product design and collaboration tools such as
  **Figma or similar platforms**
  .
* Strong
  **communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration**
  skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a
  **fast-paced startup environment**
  .
* Prior experience working on
  **AI-related SaaS products**
  is a good-to-have.

**Education & Experience**

* **4+ years of experience in Product Management**
  , preferably in B2B SaaS, technology, or product-based companies.
* Demonstrated experience of
  **end-to-end product ownership**
  , preferably in a startup or lean product environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in
  **Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field**
  .
* **IIM and IIT freshers can also apply**

Snapmint
is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered

**2,000+**

Headquartered in
**Mumbai**
, with offices across major metros including
**Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur**
, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.

Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.

**The role:**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Search at Snapmint. You'll be responsible for building a modern search engine from the ground up - one that delivers relevant, personalized results to millions of users on our app. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of product, ML, and data.

Senior Product Manager

Product

Full-time

5-8

Work from Office - 5 Days per Week

* Identify and fix search quality issues across the stack — whether the root cause is in query understanding, retrieval, ranking, or catalogue data quality
* Improve search relevance and conversion through structured experimentation - A/B testing, offline benchmarks, and human annotation
* Work closely with engineering and data science to implement ML and AI-driven improvements to search
* Define and track search-specific metrics - precision, recall, NDCG, and conversion

* Familiarity with relevance measurement techniques - NDCG, human annotation, offline benchmarks, and online A/B testing
* Basic understanding of RAG and LLM/vector search - including trade-offs

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
**About WorkIndia**

WorkIndia is India’s largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

About the Product Organization

Our product teams focus on building long-term business outcomes across multiple employer journeys. Broadly, our employer-side charter spans:

* **Hunting:**
  Focuses on acquiring and converting new employers into paying customers through strong product-led growth and onboarding experiences.
* **Farming:**
  Focuses on helping existing employers succeed consistently by improving retention, expansion, and operational scalability through product systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience**
to work on Employer Acquisition within the Hunting charter, owning end-to-end growth, conversion, and user experience.

You will define what to build, validate it through experimentation, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to ship impactful products.

This role requires strong execution ownership, first-principles thinking, user empathy, data fluency, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

1. Ownership

* Own the product roadmap, driving growth, retention, UX, and funnel performance.
* Translate business goals into a clear roadmap and product priorities.
* Identify high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, activation, and user experience.
* Balance short-term execution with the long-term health of the product.

2. User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviours, and pain points.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in real user outcomes.
* Translate user insights into scalable product improvements.
* Advocate for user impact while balancing business constraints.

3. Business & Product Leadership

* Own business outcomes for the product, not just individual features.
* Connect product decisions to measurable business impact.
* Partner with business teams to ensure product strategy reflects business goals.
* Influence cross-functional priorities and drive alignment with partner teams.

4. Execution & Systems Thinking

* Write clear PRDs with well-defined goals, scope, and success criteria.
* Design and run A/B experiments to validate major bets, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis.
* Drive high-quality execution by working closely with Engineering and Design teams through to launch.
* Identify recurring product problems and propose scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Anticipate risks and proactively adjust plans.

5. Data & Decision-Making

* Use data to drive prioritisation and product problem discovery.
* Leverage analytics and experimentation to validate hypotheses.
* Own product metrics and outcomes end-to-end.
* Distinguish meaningful business outcomes from vanity metrics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Experience (CX), Sales, and Marketing to ship and scale products.
* Create clarity in ambiguous situations and resolve trade-offs constructively.
* Lead through influence with peers and cross-functional partners.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in marketplace or consumer internet products is preferred.
* Proven experience designing and running end-to-end A/B experiments, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis, in close collaboration with Design.
* A track record of shipping user-facing features that have delivered measurable results.
* Strong data fluency and the ability to use data for prioritisation and storytelling.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Team & Reporting

* **Reports to:**
  Group Product Manager
* **Key Stakeholders:**
  Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Sales.

Why Join WorkIndia?

* **Impact:**
  Be part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives every day.
* **Growth:**
  Work in a high-ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company’s growth and culture.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout, Bangalore.

**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
AspireBooks is Aspire's accounting product: the layer that turns Aspire from a financial operations platform into the system of record for a business's finances. It is Aspire's biggest product bet, a 0→1 accounting platform targeted to the thousands of businesses already running their finances on Aspire.
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to take AspireBooks to mid-market customers. This is a builder-PM role: you won't just write specs, you'll ship working features yourself using AI coding tools, working inside the actual codebase alongside engineers. The role exists because mid-market accounting is won on depth and speed of execution, and we need someone who can deliver both.
  
  
You'll join a small, autonomous pod of product, design and engineering that ships at startup speed inside a scaled, profitable fintech, working daily with Engineering, Design and accounting domain experts, plus GTM teams in our key markets.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Own the mid-market roadmap for AspireBooks, from customer discovery with finance teams and accountants through to shipped features.
* Build and ship production features hands-on using AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar), end to end.
* Write clear specs for the features the engineering pod builds, and make the build-vs-delegate call feature by feature.
* Define and track success metrics: activation, records created, reconciliation depth and retention.
* Work with Sales and CX to land mid-market customers and turn their feedback into product.
* Shape how AI agents earn the trust of accountants inside the product.

**We would love to get to know you if you have the following**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on B2B SaaS.
* A background in fintech or B2B SaaS serving finance teams.
* Experience with workflow-heavy B2B products: invoicing, AP/AR, payments or reporting.
* A builder-PM track record: you ship working features with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), not just specs, and own discovery → delivery → code.
* Hands-on technical skills: you can read and understand code, and you implement AI in how you and your team work.

**Nice to have**

* 6+ years of product experience, including time as a lead or senior PM owning a product line end to end.
* Accounting or ERP software background (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, Odoo or similar), or close work with accountants and CFOs.
* Working knowledge of double-entry accounting (chart of accounts, journals, reconciliation, close), multi-entity and multi-currency, migration and onboarding flows, or accountant and partner channels.
* A former engineer or technical background; you have shipped production code in a scale-up.
* Experience with mid-market customers, not only SMB self-serve.
* Built end-to-end features solo (frontend + backend); pricing and packaging work; integration experience (bank feeds, tax engines, APIs).

**Why this role?**
Build the accounting product of the future, the way product will be built from now on. You'll be one of the first builder-PMs at Aspire: shipping code, not just decks, with the autonomy of a startup and the distribution of a platform.
  
  
**What You Get**

* Direct access to Aspire's product teams and founding team.
* An AI-native way of working, where every PM builds.
* A front-row seat on a 0→1 product inside a profitable, scaled fintech.
* Structured onboarding with engineering and accounting domain experts.

jobs.title: Product Owner - ERM

**Job Title: Product Owner – ERM**

* The Product Owner turns business vision into customer value by acting as the voice of the customer and the primary point of contact for demand for the team. The role manages and prioritises a transparent product backlog, translates user and business needs into actionable items, and assures clear linkage through the golden thread from strategy to delivery. Working closely with business users, Product and Technology leads, Architects and the Agile Team, the Product Owner enables the realisation of agreed OKRs and delivers compliant, secure and scalable outcomes. The role also provides delivery assurance, supports product roadmap development and balances new change with operational resilience and institutional risk considerations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define, communicate and cascade the product vision, value proposition, OKRs and roadmap across the end-to-end team so everyone remains aligned on what is to be built and why.
* Own the backlog end-to-end by managing intake and demand, expressing backlog items with acceptance criteria, prioritising demand and keeping the backlog visible, transparent and clear.
* Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, including decisions on what not to build where value is not evidenced.
* Build, refine and maintain a rolling wave product roadmap aligned to wider Value Stream and SVS goals, the Future State Architecture and re-use of existing assets where possible.

jobs.description:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
This role is positioned within the Enterprise Veeva Quality Suite - Product Team, responsible for contributing to the technical solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Veeva Quality Suite across Content Management, Quality, Audit & Risk business processes. The Product Owner in Veeva Quality Vault is responsible for requirements, managing advanced configuration change requests on lifecycles, workflows, atomic security settings, objects, reports, etc. and for testing and validation documentation in line with GSK’s Internal framework. The Product Owner is senior to the Product Analyst role and leads large scale configuration projects across Veeva Quality Vault. The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of a specific product by translating business needs into a prioritized backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Associated Director, Product Owner. The role works closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner guides Product Owner and works with Technical SMEs, Architects, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide product expertise in the Veeva Quality Suite as a certified Vault platform administrator and Veeva configuration specialist, leading large-scale configuration projects.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes within guardrails set by the Product Managers.
* Act as the product knowledge expert across multiple objects, coaching product owners and managing configuration changes for the Veeva Quality Suite in line with agreed priority backlog items.
* Lead impact assessment activities, reviewing proposed changes and ensuring impact understood across the entire Quality Suite.
* Deliver product enhancements through agreed backlog process to ensure Veeva Quality Suite evolves to meet business needs.
* Ensure Quality Vault remains compliant as a Validated Solution through supporting testing and re- validation efforts and that configuration releases from validation to production are compliant.

* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions, maintaining clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change, and ensure product changes follow required security, data, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls with specialist approvals obtained where required.
* Support architects in assessing design options, managing cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing, and act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and using feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications.
* Minimum five years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.

jobs.title: Senior Principal - Product Owner Segmentation
jobs.description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering segmentation capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering segmentation improvements that increased policy coverage, reduced risk or enabled secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

jobs.title: Manager, Underwriting Support
jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

As an Underwriting Support Manager within Zillow Home Loans, you’ll lead a growing India-based mortgage operations team focused on delivering accurate, timely, and scalable support across the underwriting lifecycle. The team partners with U.S. Underwriters and cross-functional mortgage operations teams to complete defined review, documentation, validation, and workflow activities. As the business evolves, the team’s scope may expand into additional underwriting-support functions that improve quality, reduce operational friction, and help loans progress efficiently.
  
  
As an Underwriting Support Manager, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Underwriting Support Specialists, ensuring consistent execution of assigned activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, quality standards, and service-level expectations.
  
  
You will own people leadership, day-to-day team operations, workload and capacity management, quality oversight, performance management, and continuous improvement across assigned underwriting-support activities. You’ll design and refine workflows, implement quality controls, and use data to drive performance across quality, speed, and partner experience. You will partner closely with U.S. Underwriting leaders and other mortgage operations teams to resolve escalations, strengthen handoffs, and build scalable processes as the function grows.
  
  
This role leads underwriting-support execution within defined authority and escalation paths; it does not independently assume final underwriting approval or credit-exception authority.

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Underwriting Support Specialists, setting clear expectations and fostering accountability, sound judgment, collaboration, and professional growth.
* Own daily team operations, including queue management, workload allocation, staffing coverage, and prioritization based on service levels, loan urgency, customer commitments, and business priorities.
* Oversee assigned loan-file reviews, documentation and data validation, and workflow activities to ensure accurate, complete, consistent, and timely execution.
* Monitor team performance through measures such as turnaround time, service-level adherence, productivity, backlog aging, defect rates, and rework; use insights to address gaps and improve results.
* Conduct regular quality reviews and calibration sessions, identify recurring defects, and implement coaching and corrective actions that improve first-pass accuracy and reduce downstream rework.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for support-related issues; resolve matters within assigned authority and promptly route complex, high-risk, out-of-policy, or time-sensitive scenarios to the appropriate Underwriter or functional leader.
* Partner with Underwriting, Processing, Closing, Quality Control, Credit Specialists, and other mortgage operations teams to resolve file-level issues, clarify responsibilities, and improve handoffs.
* Partner with Underwriting and Enablement leaders to support onboarding, training, and readiness assessments; reinforce consistent application of SOPs, checklists, documentation standards, and escalation paths.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones and performance discussions, provide actionable feedback, and support individual development and career growth.
* Maintain and improve team SOPs, checklists, trackers, and operating controls in partnership with process owners; ensure changes are communicated, understood, and consistently applied.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying process gaps and opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve tools and system usage.
* Lead the team through evolving processes, systems, products, and work assignments; support the controlled introduction of additional underwriting-support activities.
* Ensure accurate system updates and loan-file records, and maintain the confidentiality and privacy of borrower, customer, and employee information.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have 5+ years of experience in U.S. residential mortgage underwriting, underwriting support, quality control, loan processing, closing, credit review, fraud review, or a related mortgage operations function, including 1+ year of leadership or management experience.
* You have strong knowledge of core residential mortgage documentation, underwriting principles, risk indicators, and loan workflows, with an understanding of applicable agency guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company policies relevant to assigned support activities. You exercise sound judgment within defined authority and escalation requirements.
* You are a strong people leader who sets clear expectations, builds trust, provides effective coaching, and develops individual contributors.

* Proven ability to read and translate Open API/Swagger Specs and UCRs to defi ne and document API requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, data models)
* Experience delivering API/integration change across the full lifecycle, working with engineering, architecture, and 3rd parties.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong facilitation and negotiation skills
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role will be based in our Bengaluru, India office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.
* Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
* Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
* Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
* Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
* Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
* Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
* Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

jobs.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
Scientific/Technology
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson Corporate Business Technology, we power J&J employees with technology to shape the future of healthcare. This critical role is about building the next generation of digital service, moving the customer experience from interaction-first to resolution-first, by leveraging AI and autonomous (agentic) capabilities to solve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end and drive significant operational efficiency. This individual will own the Generative AI and Agentic Roadmap and its required foundational platform components, ensuring seamless integration into the enterprise customer portal, developer portal, and underlying API products. The individual in this role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to drive development and integration, establish and maintain alignment between the customer experience and development roadmaps, and serve as a champion for safe, reliable, and high-quality autonomous experiences.
  
  
**The Main Responsibilities**

* Architecting the AI Future: Work collaboratively and cross-functionally to define the vision for the Lumen Platform's Generative AI strategy, specifically focusing on how Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous/agentic systems can resolve complex B2B customer issues end-to-end, aligned with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
* Bridging Technical & Business Needs: Translate complex B2B customer journeys and business requirements (e.g., ticket creation, service modification, billing inquiries) into clear, actionable technical specifications for AI Agents, conversational interfaces, and workflow automation systems and their required underlying Tooling/APIs and orchestration logic.
* Deep Customer & AI Feedback Engagement: Engage regularly with customers and platform users to capture real-world feedback on AI accuracy, trust, and usability. Leverage these insights to inform the Agentic AI continuous learning and refinement roadmap, ensuring high user satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).
* Championing the AI Tooling Layer: Advocate for and drive an API-first strategy to ensure the platform provides a robust, governed, and structured Tooling Layer that AI models and autonomous agents can reliably call for action (e.g., defining API standards, taxonomy, and latency requirements for AI consumption).
* Driving AI Execution & Governance: Lead execution of the Generative AI and Agentic roadmap, defining detailed capabilities, LLM integration requirements, and Guardrails & Safety protocols (including Prompt Injection Prevention, data masking, and compliance checks) to mitigate risks like hallucination and data leakage.
* AI Performance & Lifecycle Management: Implement rigorous AI Governance and MLOps practices. Define and track key performance indicators including Task Success Rate, Hallucination Rate, Cost Per Interaction (CPI), and Agent Latency, ensuring solutions are robust, and changes are vetted against these metrics before release. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve the end-to-end roadmap execution process, driving key learnings back into the organization.

**What We Look For In a Candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering); master's degree is a plus.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Technical Product Management or Software Engineering, including 3+ years directly defining and launching Generative AI capabilities (specifically Agentic AI, large-scale conversational interfaces, or autonomous workflows).
* Deep expertise in Generative AI architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns, and the design of AI 'tools' or functions for autonomous agents.
* Deep technical knowledge and understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL, Event Driven APIs), microservices architecture, and cloud platforms.
* Extensive experience with digital platforms, enterprise customer portals, and/or complex web applications, coupled with strong working knowledge of user experience design & research, and modern software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps).
* Proven ability to analyze complex technical data, identify and troubleshoot intricate technical issues, and develop scalable solutions that directly impact the customer and developer experience on the platform.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills that enable effective collaboration with diverse technical and non-technical teams, stakeholders, and customers. Ability to create clarity and drive focus in complex and dynamic technical contexts up, down, and across the organization.
* Ability to manage and lead multiple technical priorities and projects while delivering against tight timelines in a complex and dynamic environment.

For nearly 100 years, we have been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

### **Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

We do not just talk about progress and innovation, we make it happen with our customers and in the communities where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled **Senior IT Analyst Applications – Engineering Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst** to join our **Solar IT Solutions – ERP Team, Caterpillar IT Division, Bangalore**.

The incumbent will bring strong functional expertise in **Baan / Infor LN, Engineering processes, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), engineering master data and Global Trade Compliance (GTC)**. This role will serve as a key bridge between **Engineering, Global Trade Compliance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics and IT teams**, ensuring engineering product data and ERP processes effectively support global trade compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with **Baan / Infor LN engineering and manufacturing processes**, including **Item Master, Package Bill of Materials (BoM), Multi-Site BoM, Engineering Change Management, Windchill/PLM integration and Engineering Release-to-Production**, combined with working knowledge of Global Trade Compliance requirements such as **product classification, export control classification, HS/HTS codes, country of origin and trade-related product attributes**.

The role requires the ability to understand how engineering decisions and product-data changes impact downstream trade compliance processes, translate regulatory and business requirements into functional ERP solutions, and drive accurate, controlled and scalable product-data processes across global operations.

**The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, Karnataka, India.**

### **What You Will Do**

### **Engineering & Global Trade Compliance Process Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of end-to-end **Engineering-to-Global Trade Compliance processes** across Baan / Infor LN and connected enterprise applications.
* Analyse engineering product structures, item attributes and master-data dependencies that influence trade compliance processes.
* Work with Engineering and Global Trade Compliance stakeholders to understand requirements related to: Product and commodity classification HS / HTS classification Export control classification Country of origin Trade-related engineering attributes Product structures and Bills of Materials Engineering changes Product release and lifecycle processes
* Identify how engineering changes to products, components, materials or product structures may affect downstream compliance data and processes.
* Define opportunities to strengthen integration, data accuracy, traceability and process standardisation between Engineering, ERP and Global Trade Compliance.

### **Baan / Infor LN Functional Expertise**

* Provide strong functional business-analysis expertise across **Baan / Infor LN Engineering and Manufacturing processes**.
* Understand and analyse the configuration and use of: Item Master Engineering Items Engineering Bills of Material Production Bills of Material Package BoMs Multi-Site BoMs Item and Engineering attributes Engineering Change processes Routings and manufacturing structures Product release processes
* Analyse the impact of Baan / Infor LN master-data and transactional changes on Global Trade Compliance processes.
* Translate Engineering and Trade Compliance requirements into functional requirements and solution designs.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Business Analysis.

**In this role, you will:**

* Business Analysts are at the centre of how Transformation shapes, delivers and embeds change working with the business and our delivery partners. They are typically responsible for Requirements Management, Design, Change Management and Implementation Management. Business Analysts work collaboratively with delivery partners and subject matter experts in gathering, translating and clarifying requirements and defining design options. In systems related projects and programmes, the role holder will support technology delivery partners with the translation of business requirements and designs into more detailed functional requirements and designs, often representing the voice of the customer and business in these discussions.
* The Business Analyst Change Management activities span from early change planning and audience analysis; through to designing and delivering change interventions (e.g. communications, training, support, organisation alignment); and tracking and taking actions on change readiness, adoption, and feedback. They are also responsible for Implementation Management, including planning, controlling and reporting on implementation of the change ‘product’, focusing on accelerating benefits and minimising risk during deployment. Implementation activities will also include managing implementation readiness and managing the early stages of implementation (e.g. pilot).
* The role holder will work in Risk and Compliance Transformation (RCT) which manages the Change the Bank investment portfolio and associated transformation activity on behalf of and across the Risk and Compliance function globally. It is accountable for the global, cross functional change agenda, delivering mandatory/regulatory and strategic change programmes on behalf of Global Risk and Compliance, in partnership with regional teams and in support of business partner control needs. It designs, leads and delivers large scale, complex global change across multiple geographies and jurisdictions, impacting regions and business lines, including system, people and process changes, ensuring the change programmes adhere to the change standards laid out by HSBC and using mandated tools and methods.
* Risk and Compliance Transformation is part of the Chief Operating Office (COO) sub function which is responsible for providing services to ensure the efficient and effective management and operational running of the function.
* Content heavy role – Business Analysts must demonstrate strong business knowledge and sound business sense, and stay abreast of the industry, business-wise and technology-wise.
* Stakeholder complexity – Business Analysts will often need gather requirements and agree designs across business stakeholders, dealing with different interests and resolving disagreements and conflicts, and sometimes needing to challenge poor requirements and design decisions. * Multi-disciplinary – Business Analysts need to be able to shape business requirements and solution designs that encompass all aspects of the delivery (customer, people, process, policy, technology - system, data, infrastructure, etc.). **Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Department:**
Commercial

**NEWCOLD BHARAT REEFER PRIVATE LIMITED**
has been recognized as a
**winner of The Hindu Best Places to Work Awards 2026, powered by WorkL**
.

**ABOUT NEWCOLD**

NewCold is a global leader in advanced cold chain logistics, specializing in the development and operation of highly automated cold storage facilities. With operations across multiple continents and a rapidly expanding footprint, NewCold combines cutting-edge technology, automation, and data-driven decision making to provide innovative logistics solutions to leading food manufacturers worldwide.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded
**Senior Business Analyst**
to drive strategic insights, business transformation initiatives, and operational excellence across the organization.

**Position is integral to AUNZ region growth.**

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

The Senior Business Analyst will serve as a strategic partner to Commercial, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and Leadership teams by transforming complex datasets into actionable business insights.

The role will support pricing across warehousing and transport operations, customer business case development, transport network design, warehouse capacity planning, productivity analysis, and strategic commercial decisions. Working closely with Commercial, Business Development, Operations, Customer Service and Finance teams, the Senior Business Analyst will translate ambiguous business problems, customer requirements and operational data into actionable recommendations and practical supply chain solutions.

The role also involves mentoring junior analysts, driving analytical best practices, and fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business & Commercial Analytics**

* Analyze large-scale business, operational, customer, and financial datasets to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Develop pricing, profitability, and commercial performance models that support strategic decision-making.
* Deliver actionable insights related to revenue enhancement, margin improvement, customer profitability, and sales effectiveness.
* Conduct forecasting, scenario planning, demand analysis, and business case evaluations.
* Support strategic initiatives through advanced data analysis and evidence-based recommendations.

**Data Management & Advanced Analytics**

* Independently manage, cleanse, structure, validate, and interpret large and complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Act as the custodian of data integrity and help establish a robust "Single Source of Truth" across business functions.
* Build scalable analytical frameworks for recurring business analysis and reporting.
* Utilize AI and emerging analytical technologies to improve data processing, predictive insights, and business decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting and analytical tasks.

**Process Modelling & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead process mapping, process modelling, and business process optimization initiatives across functional areas.
* Analyze end-to-end workflows to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Design future-state processes aligned with operational and commercial objectives.
* Drive Lean, continuous improvement, and business transformation projects to achieve measurable business benefits.

**Business Intelligence & Reporting**

* Design, develop, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards and management reports.
* Create executive-level reporting that provides clear visibility into KPIs, operational performance, commercial outcomes, and financial metrics.
* Ensure reporting standards, data consistency, and governance practices are maintained.
* Develop automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve analytical accuracy.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Senior Leadership, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and IT teams.
* Influence decision-making by providing clear, data-driven recommendations.
* Manage, coach, and mentor junior analysts and support their professional development.
* Review analytical outputs produced by junior team members to ensure quality and consistency.
* Lead analytical workstreams and improvement initiatives across multiple business functions.

**Strategic Thinking & Innovation**

* Demonstrate initiative by proactively identifying issues, opportunities, and business improvement areas before they arise.
* Think beyond immediate requirements and evaluate long-term business implications.
* Act as a trusted advisor by challenging assumptions and driving strategic discussions using data and insights.
* Champion innovation, AI adoption, and best analytical practices across the organization.

**Commercial & Operational Analysis**

* Develop pricing models, profitability analysis, forecasts and business cases to support commercial decision-making.
* Translate complex business questions into clear insights and practical recommendations for Commercial, Operations and Finance stakeholders.
* Analyse commercial, operational and financial data to identify revenue growth, margin improvement and cost optimisation opportunities.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Finance and other relevant departments across Australia and New Zealand.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision, managing priorities and delivering high-quality analytical outcomes in a remote environment.
* Present findings and recommendations clearly to support decision-making at all levels of the business.

**Data & Reporting**

* Independently manage, validate and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Drive data quality and support a reliable "Single Source of Truth" across the business.
